biography: Leonardo "Leo" Flores grew up in the shadow of Interlagos, the roar of engines a constant soundtrack to his childhood. His father, a mechanic for a local touring car team, instilled a love of racing early on, letting young Leo tinker with carburetors and dream of glory. He began his racing career in karting, dominating the local scene with an aggressive, no-holds-barred style that earned him both victories and a few trips to the stewards' office. Finances were always tight, forcing Leo to learn the value of every tenth of a second and every carefully conserved tire. His big break came when Fusca Classic FL, a small but ambitious team specializing in vintage Volkswagen racing, offered him a seat. While it's not F1, Leo sees it as a stepping stone, a chance to prove his mettle and attract the attention of bigger teams. He's currently mid-season, fighting tooth and nail for every point, his sights set on the championship title. His determination is fueled by the memory of his father, who always believed in him, even when no one else did.
drivingStyle: Flores is an aggressive driver, known for his late-braking maneuvers and willingness to take risks. He has a natural feel for the car's limit, often pushing it to the very edge of control. Tire management isn't his strongest suit, as his aggressive style tends to wear them down quickly, a weakness he is actively working to improve. Under pressure, he becomes even more tenacious, thriving in wheel-to-wheel battles and refusing to yield an inch. He is a master of the undercut strategy.
rivalries: Ricardo Silva: Silva, a veteran of the Fusca Classic series, represents the old guard that Leo is trying to displace. Their contrasting driving styles – Silva smooth and calculated, Flores aggressive and impulsive – often lead to heated on-track battles.

Isabela Costa: Costa is a rising star in her own right, and her and Leo’s frequent clashes for podium positions have created a fierce rivalry. Their off-track banter is just as intense as their on-track battles.
Mateus Oliveira: Oliveira, the son of a wealthy businessman, has access to superior equipment, fueling Leo's resentment and determination to beat him on pure skill.
quirks: Always wears the same pair of lucky socks, inherited from his grandfather, on race day.
Listens to a specific Brazilian samba song moments before getting into the car to calm his nerves.
Has a habit of tapping his helmet three times before the start of each race.
famousQuote: Second place is just the first loser.
careerHighlight: Winning the Interlagos Karting Championship in 2018, a victory that caught the attention of several racing teams and marked the beginning of his professional career.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead in the final lap of the 2022 Rio de Janeiro Grand Prix due to a mechanical failure, costing him a potential race win and severely damaging his championship hopes.
